gpu.name: NVIDIA A40
gpu.interpretation: GPU at 99.1 % of max SM clock and 94.9 % of its power cap, 100 % util with zero samples below 95 %. It is doing real, saturating work and cannot have run ~2x faster in the past for an environmental reason.

cgroup_memory.interpretation: failcnt 0 settles it: this cgroup has NEVER hit its limit. rss 16.1 / 50 GB. The 33 GB of `cache` is reclaimable page cache and is NOT pressure (CLAUDE.md cgroup trap). oom_kill 24 is historical (C-REFCV3-EVAL-DEATH), not current. shmem 4.97 GB == the 6 workers x prefetch 1 x 0.826 GB of in-flight uint8 batches, exactly as the trainer banner predicts.

processes.interpretation: One trainer, no contention. Workers are overwhelmingly in S (sleeping on a full output queue), never observed in D (uninterruptible block-IO wait) across 180 process-samples.

io.backing_store: dm-1 over nvme0n1 + nvme1n1 (RAID-1 NVMe); /root/data is on the container overlay, NOT the MooseFS /workspace mount
io.interpretation: DECISIVE: the device is 96.8 % IDLE with an average queue depth of 0.15 while serving 155.7 MB/s. The store is nowhere near saturated and could serve far more if asked. IO and page-cache state are REFUTED as the cause.

unusable_probes.delayacct_blkio_ticks: read 0 for every process; kernel.task_delayacct is disabled in this container, so the field is CONSTANT ZERO and proves nothing. Not evidence of absent IO wait.
